description:
Hola, somos L'Oréal. No solo construimos marcas, damos forma a la manera en que el mundo experimenta la belleza (y se necesitan muchos trabajos geniales para lograrlo). ¿Intrigado? Sigue leyendo, esta podría ser la oportunidad que has estado buscando.

Un Día en la Vida

Como parte de nuestro Programa de Internship, tendrás la oportunidad de vivir la experiencia L'Oréal desde adentro, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios y contribuyendo a proyectos reales que generan un impacto directo en el negocio en México. Durante un año, formarás parte de un ambiente dinámico donde aprenderás, crecerás y pondrás en práctica tus conocimientos académicos en un entorno profesional real.

Consolidar el reporte de zona para la zona LATAM en Comercial y Educación que debe ser reportado a nivel global.

Buscamos personas con pensamiento estratégico, proactivas y con muchas ganas de aprender y aportar desde el primer día.

Quiénes Somos

L'Oréal Groupe está presente en 150 mercados en cinco continentes. Desde hace más de un siglo, L'Oréal Groupe se ha dedicado únicamente a un negocio: "crear la belleza que mueve al mundo"; hoy es el líder mundial de la industria. Juntos, resolvemos desafíos complejos a gran escala, mientras nos mantenemos comprometidos con hacer del mundo un lugar más inclusivo y mejor para todos y para nuestro planeta. Nuestro Programa de Internship está diseñado para atraer el mejor talento joven de México, ofreciendo una experiencia transversal que abarca distintas divisiones de L'Oréal Groupe, desde Productos de Consumo hasta Lujo, Belleza Dermatológica y Funciones Corporativas, brindando una visión integral del negocio de la belleza.

Estamos comprometidos con garantizar procesos de selección inclusivos y con defender la contratación y promoción de cada candidato de manera ética y equitativa. description:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The E-commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

Responsibilities


 Support central projects to drive platform growth and achieve multiple targets, including but not limited to campaigns, affiliate, content scenarios, shoptab.
 Able to conduct meticulous resource management, market research and other operational works with moderate guidance.
 Coordinate related cross-functional teams' resources to ensure the normal and orderly development and implementation of the projects.
 Communicate with back-end support teams to keep optimizing infrastructure construction.
 Conduct consistent tracking of project performance metrics as required. Able to identify and come up with improvement plans for responsible projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently in the penultimate year pursuing a bachelor's degree.
 Familiarity with short video, live stream and content-based e-commerce in the local market.
 Good interpersonal skills, strong ownership and result-driven. Able to adapt to the flexible working cadence of the team.
 Internship experience in large ecommerce platforms, or leading Internet companies is a plus.
 Good understanding of the ecommerce industry & its business structure, consumer needs and demand, influencers, social media, e-commerce, livestreaming, and digital trends landscape.
 Able to commit to at least 3 months internship, 6 months internship preferred.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
ES EL MOMENTO

Santander (www.santander.com) está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología, y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo, la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar.

Esto es más que un cambio estratégico: es una oportunidad para crecer, aprender y generar un impacto real.

Nuestra misión es contribuir a que más personas y empresas prosperen. Adoptamos una sólida cultura de riesgos y esperamos que todos nuestros equipos asuman un enfoque proactivo y responsable en la gestión del riesgo.




EL IMPACTO QUE GENERARÁS

Openbank México está buscando un CRM Specialist para transformar datos de clientes, campañas y comportamiento digital en información accionable que permita optimizar las estrategias de adquisición, activación, retención y crecimiento del negocio. La posición formará parte del área de Data & IA y estará ubicada en Ciudad de México.

La posición será responsable de analizar el desempeño de campañas, desarrollar segmentaciones y audiencias, construir dashboards y participar en la ejecución y automatización de comunicaciones mediante plataformas de Customer Engagement.

Trabajarás de manera transversal con los equipos de CRM, Marketing, Producto, Growth, Data y Tecnología, identificando oportunidades, monitoreando indicadores y convirtiendo grandes volúmenes de datos en recomendaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones.

Tu trabajo contribuirá directamente a mejorar la conversión, fortalecer el engagement, incrementar la retención y optimizar el valor de los clientes, asegurando la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información utilizada en las campañas.

AI-First Growth Marketer

Location: Remote – Mexico

Industry: Financial Services / Private Lending / Real Estate Financing

We are hiring an AI-First Growth Marketer for a U.S.-based private direct lender that funds business-purpose real estate loans nationwide, including fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction and DSCR rental loans across a wide range of loan sizes. The company markets to two audiences: real estate investors who borrow and loan brokers who refer deals.

As the company's first dedicated marketing hire, you will own the function end to end. You write a short, data-backed plan, a company partner approves it, and you build and ship it yourself. Over time, you will run marketing entirely, reporting directly to a partner.

Above all, we are looking for an AI power user backed by real marketing experience. You use Claude and other AI tools every day to research, build, automate and produce work, and your experience tells you where to aim them. Where you lack depth, you learn fast with AI or direct and check a specialist; outside help is the exception.

Build GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, lead routing, nurture sequences and a recurring newsletter for borrowers and brokers
Create segments such as borrowers by loan type, experience and state, and brokers by deal volume
Clean data safely, with backups and test runs before any bulk change

Earn citations in ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and emerging AI agents, and keep business listings consistent
Build lead magnets and A/B test landing pages, starting with the application and broker pages
Build backlinks at scale and source, pitch and write PR, feature and guest post placements


Social Media & Community


Share helpful, non-spammy content on LinkedIn, BiggerPockets, Reddit, Quora, investor forums and Facebook groups from a monthly calendar
Lightly manage the existing reviews setup


AI Content & Sales Enablement


Produce emails, landing pages, graphics, direct mail, one-pagers, term sheets, case studies and broker kits with AI
Maintain the brand guidelines and prompts the AI follows, and turn each funded deal into multiple content formats
Check all output for accuracy, loan terms and brand voice before it goes out


Data, Direct Mail, Automation & Paid Ads


Build targeted lists and enrich the CRM with data enrichment providers, and run hyper-personalized, measured direct mail campaigns
Replace manual work with automation and AI through Make.com, Zapier and GoHighLevel's AI tools
Later, once baselines exist, own paid ads (likely through GoHighLevel), including cost per lead and lead quality by channel


Qualifications

Required Qualifications


AI power user first: heavy daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with AI agents, automations or live dashboards you built yourself
3+ years as the only or second marketer at a small company or startup, covering several channels long term
Hands-on CRM automation (GoHighLevel ideal; HubSpot or ActiveCampaign also count)
Make.com, Zapier or n8n, with enough understanding of APIs and webhooks to troubleshoot
GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTMs and attribution, including live dashboards used by leadership
SEO work with measurable results, plus working knowledge of AEO and WordPress
Proven growth of a brand on social media and in online communities
Ability to produce creatives and sales materials with AI tools and Canva
Track record of finding, testing and rolling out new marketing tools with results that justified them
Strong data sense to catch errors in AI output and data; self-directed without a playbook
C1+ English (written and spoken) and full, exclusive commitment during U.S. Eastern hours

Paid ads on Google or Meta, including through GoHighLevel
Direct mail campaign experience
Gravity Forms and WordPress-to-CRM integrations

description:
Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Compensation: $1,160,000 - $1,510,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Brinks, Build-a-Bear, Smith, Asana, Slack, Figma, AutoDesk, and Glassdoor.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward.


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Content Marketing Specialist to manage video and written content across the company's digital channels.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys storytelling, understands how to create content for different platforms, and can independently manage the process from content development to publishing.

description:
Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Purpose of the Role

Regional content studios are part of MOM's regional hubs, helping markets deliver the right content faster through greater reuse, better coordination and consistent ways of working. They focus primarily on adapting global content for local markets, while supporting local brand content where needed, using the tools, capabilities and processes defined by the central team. Diageo teams lead the studio, while agency partners deliver creative adaptation and production.

The Regional Content Operations Lead manages content demand and delivery for assigned categories across markets. This role is the day-to-day link between market and brand teams and the agency delivery team, reviewing briefs, challenging low-value requests, maximising reuse, choosing the right delivery route and ensuring assets are delivered on time and ready for approval, storage and reuse.

Key Accountabilities


Manage content demand and delivery for assigned categories, with a primary focus on adapting GBT assets for market use.
Review and clarify briefs from markets and brand teams, challenging unclear, duplicated or low-value asks and improving briefing quality over time.
Check for reuse before production and decide the most efficient route: reuse, GBT asset adaptation, Pencil/AI production, agency production or new-to-world only where truly needed.
Translate market needs into clear agency briefs, including assets, formats, mandatories, timelines, approval needs, delivery route and creative direction.
Guide the agency on workflows, templates, production approach and adaptation requirements, reviewing outputs where needed to ensure they are fit for purpose.
Track status, risks and missing inputs through the Planning & Briefing Platform, escalating issues and ensuring final assets are ready for approval, storage, tagging and reuse.


Key Competencies


 Brand Proposition
 Brand Activation


Qualifications And Experience Required


CONTENT DELIVERY EXPERIENCE: 6+ years of experience in content delivery, creative operations, marketing operations, agency account management, brand management, production or regional marketing.
CREATIVE JUDGMENT: Strong in-house or creative agency background, with the ability to understand briefs, judge outputs, provide clear feedback and bridge brand teams and agency partners.
BRIEFING & ADAPTATION EXPERTISE: Strong understanding of content briefing, reuse, adaptation, production workflows, approval requirements and market delivery needs.
AI & TOOL KNOWLEDGE: Good working knowledge of AI-enabled production, Pencil or similar tools, DAM/Libraries and content planning platforms.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Able to manage multiple briefs, deadlines, stakeholders and agency workflows at the same time.
PUSHBACK & EXECUTION: Detail-oriented and confident challenging weak briefs or unnecessary new creation, with focus on speed, reuse, cost efficiency, quality and market service.


Diversity Statement

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: Editorial Content Specialist (SEO & AEO)
description:
For the curious writers and search obsessed.

You know that feeling when you search for something and find an article that actually answers your question, no robotic filler, no keyword stuffing, just great taste and genuine utility? That’s the exact energy we care about.

We’re looking for an Editorial Content Specialist who loves the sweet spot where storytelling meets search intelligence. Someone who crafts pieces creative pros actually want to read, while understanding how modern search and answer engines discover and surface that work.

A Little About Us

Envato is an all-in-one creative toolkit, bringing together world-class creative assets and purpose-built AI tools to help people make their ideas real.

Our community is made up of designers, filmmakers, editors and creators who care about craft, love experimenting and are always looking for the next tool, technique or spark of inspiration to make better work.

What’s the gig?

You’ll be creating and editing tutorials, guides, and articles that solve real problems for creative pros. You’ll be digging into search trends and AI search behaviours to find untapped content gaps, producing fresh pieces that rank in traditional search and get cited in AI answer overviews.

You’ll be using generative AI daily to speed up your ideation and drafting, always backing it up with your sharp editorial eye so everything sounds human, clear, and on-brand.

You’ll also be publishing directly in WordPress, curating visuals from Envato, optimising internal links, and checking performance data to iterate on what works best alongside our Search Visibility team and external contributors.

Sound like you?

You have 5+ years of experience in writing, content marketing, or editorial roles, ideally within creative tools or tech. You know organic search inside out and already understand how answer engine optimization (AEO) and AI summaries work.

Generative AI is a natural part of your daily creative workflow, you’re confident managing content in WordPress, and you communicate fluently in both English and Spanish. Most of all, you bring strong editorial judgement and take pride in work that real humans enjoy reading.

Show Us What You’ve Got

Send us 2–3 writing samples or live links you’re proud of that showcase your editorial tone, storytelling skills, and how you explain creative concepts clearly.

Life at Envato

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values  : Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

Our benefits in Mexico include 30 days of Christmas bonus pay, 12 days of vacation in your first year, a 100% vacation bonus, monthly grocery vouchers, a 5% savings fund, private health insurance, home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year, plus our Conoce México benefit to help you explore more of Mexico.

A few things before you apply

We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions.

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy . We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time
Location: Remote




The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

3. Experience working directly with research teams and technical leadership.

4. Familiarity with academic publishing, AI benchmarks, evaluations, citations, and research dissemination.

5. Experience launching technical content or research that achieved meaningful adoption, citations, community engagement, or industry impact.

Role Title: Product Marketing Reviewer (Remote)

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on go-to-market strategies tailored to independent retail operations. Specifically, we are evaluating a new appointment management tool designed for independent bicycle repair shops. This research helps us refine our initial product positioning and identify hidden risks before launch.




How It Works

You will complete an asynchronous, remote review of a short go-to-market brief. During this task, you will read through our target audience assumptions, proposed messaging, and launch plan. Next, you will write a short report that clearly separates unsubstantiated assumptions from hard evidence. Today, private practice doctor’s offices, small and large hospice centers, and some of the largest healthcare organizations in the United States rely on TigerConnect. We’re a fun, hungry, smart, innovative group of eclectic people who are passionate about transforming the way clinical care teams work and communicate.

We are seeking a highly motivated Customer Experience Specialist to support customers within TigerConnect’s digitally managed Customer Success portfolio post-implementation.

This role is designed for a proactive, accountable, and strategic thinker who excels at managing customer relationships, balancing multiple priorities, and independently driving customer needs toward successful outcomes.

As a Digital Customer Experience Specialist, you will focus on leveraging digital-first strategies to maximize customer value and success with TigerConnect’s platform, products, and tools. You will balance customer needs with business goals by using customer data and insights to improve clinical communication, drive adoption and retention, identify risk, and guide customers toward value realization. You will operate primarily through scalable digital engagement while recognizing when personalized intervention, escalation, or cross-functional collaboration is necessary to achieve the right customer outcome.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Nurture Relationships: Serve as a trusted advisor, establishing and nurturing strong customer relationships through clear, timely, and proactive communication while taking ownership of customer needs through resolution or confirmed handoff.
Personalize Customer Experience: Use sound judgment to understand individual customer needs and provide personalized support and guidance that strengthens relationships and helps customers achieve successful outcomes.
Drive Customer Health: Monitor customer adoption, engagement, satisfaction, utilization, and renewal context to identify risks and opportunities. Use customer data and insights to prioritize outreach and proactively guide customers toward value realization, best practices, workflow improvements, and additional TigerConnect solutions.
Manage Digital Campaigns: Execute digital campaigns and scalable customer engagement motions (e.g., email sequences, surveys, targeted outreach, webinars, in-app messaging), maintaining strong follow-through and operational discipline across assigned initiatives.
Reinforce Onboarding Success: Provide timely, effective post-implementation support primarily through digital channels (e.g., email, chat, webinars, self-service content), helping customers build on their implementation and achieve continued value from TigerConnect.
Improve Processes: Take initiative in identifying opportunities to improve team workflows and customer-facing processes. Develop and document SOPs for new or evolving processes based on frontline experience, helping create clear, consistent, and scalable ways of working.
Manage Risk: Proactively identify at-risk customers using available customer data and engagement signals, prioritize appropriate interventions, and maintain clear ownership, communication, and follow-through until the risk is addressed or appropriately transitioned.
Expand the Business: Identify and recommend additional TigerConnect services, products, features, and workflows when they align with customer goals and opportunities to improve clinical communication and teamwork.
Own Cross-Functional Handoffs: Maintain clear accountability through internal handoffs and collaborate effectively with partner teams to progress customer needs. Adapt to evolving tools, processes, and digital strategies while maintaining ownership and follow-through through the appropriate next step or resolution.

Overview

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.

Within CE&S, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

As a Technical Support Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of support engineering roles with deep product knowledge that resolve customer technical issues. You will manage the customer relationship from a support standpoint, enable your team to deliver a great customer experience and drive Microsoft Product Improvement. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth and hone your customer relationship management skills. You will develop deep technology industry knowledge and become adept at building and leading diverse teams.

This role is Microsoft onsite only.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities


People Management: You lead a team of product experts that solve complex customer technical issues by practicing leadership principles, driving accountability and attracting/ retaining great people.
Response and Resolution: You manage the customer relationship with regards to Technical Support and act as an escalation point for Support Engineers to remove roadblocks.
Readiness: You ensure your team has the technical skills required to provide a great customer experience.
Product/Process Improvement: You ensure your team understands the product feedback cycle and participate in case triage meetings. You identify the right resources to implement automation or tools.
Business Integration: You establish engagement strategy to promote effective collaboration across other teams and organizations to enable a great customer experience.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or related field AND 3+ years of operational excellence, delivery management, account management, sales, or vendor management experience 
OR 5+ years of operational excellence, delivery management, account management, sales, or vendor management experience
OR equivalent experience.
1+ year(s) of experience of managing people.
Ability to read, write, and speak fluent English

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager to work with our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies. This is a technical role, in which you will have an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’.

As a Technical Account Manager, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs proactive scope and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical direction to help plan and build solutions using standard methodologies, and enthusiastically keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The closer relationships developed with your customers will empower you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:


 Provide support to resolve inquiries from Enterprise customers regarding AWS service or Cloud.

 Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed prelaunch planning
 Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
Foster trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.

This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will: 
Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.
Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.
Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.
Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.
Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.
Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.
Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.
Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.
Ensure installation partners are trained and follow Samsara standards.
Monitor CSAT related to installation events and resolve root causes of dissatisfaction.
Provide proactive communication and transparency with customers during install projects.
Define and continuously improve the installation coordination process using AI and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools to enhance efficiency and scale globally.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in field operations coordination, customer implementation, or technical deployment.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple installs in parallel.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written).
Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with cross-functional collaboration.

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization, automation and AI, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment.
Possesses strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
Has familiarity or hands-on experience with AI and RPA tools to drive operational efficiency.
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.

This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will: 
Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.
Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.
Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.
Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.
Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.
Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.
Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.
Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.
Ensure installation partners are trained and follow Samsara standards.
Monitor CSAT related to installation events and resolve root causes of dissatisfaction.
Provide proactive communication and transparency with customers during install projects.
Define and continuously improve the installation coordination process using AI and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools to enhance efficiency and scale globally.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in field operations coordination, customer implementation, or technical deployment.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple installs in parallel.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written).
Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with cross-functional collaboration.

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization, automation and AI, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment.
Possesses strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
Has familiarity or hands-on experience with AI and RPA tools to drive operational efficiency.
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Professional Services Manager

Why SailPoint?
Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the awards to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, we want you to join our team.

SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Center of Security and IT.  Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.

Who You Are:

Professional Services Managers are self-directed, highly motivated, and experienced leaders that thrive when overseeing and building a services organization. You have significant experience building and maintaining professional relationships, and you are comfortable communicating with people at all organizational levels. You have exceptional leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities that you use to balance customer, team and individual need while contributing to a positive work environment. You are an exceptional multitasker, able to meet and manage moving deadlines, gauge risks, and creatively resolve unexpected issues. By leveraging your extensive experience and motivation for success, you enjoy identifying growth areas, evaluating best practices, and presenting solutions to everyday problems.

Path to Success:

As a Professional Services Manager (PSM) part of SailPoint’s PS team, you will support each customer’s journey by managing the strategic efforts required to deliver SailPoint’s solutions. You will combine your management experience with our world-class product and process training to gain a deep understanding of our SaaS and/or Software delivery practices.


Within the first month, you will begin to understand your responsibilities by working with tenured management to shadow projects and sales efforts to begin taking accountability for the client experience on projects you are assigned to while developing a relationship with your peers. 
At the end of the three months, you will be responsible for engagement scoping, client communication, internal team management, escalation support, and overall service delivery for your portfolio.



• Upon completion of your first year, you will leverage your acquired skills to oversee your team and oversee the full scope of customer engagements. Concurrently, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers, peers, and leaders, and you will be accountable for fostering your team members' professional growth and assisting them in setting and achieving their goals.

Responsibilities:

Ensure that services are provided, implemented correctly, and billed in a timely and accurate manner
Partner cross-functionally during the sales process, own the services portions of deals, including presentations, RFP responses, and proposal/SOW generation 
Interact with sales reps and sales leadership during the pre-sales and post-sales (delivery) phases

Identify new opportunities for expanding SailPoint solutions and services footprint to maximize client success and SailPoint revenue growth
Take responsibility for the management of the team, including participation in staffing decisions, utilization management, performance reviews, and career development support
Assist direct reports in career development by providing regular feedback, coaching and guidance on personal development 
Coach Engagement Managers and project team members on project performance and development areas
Participate in recruiting and employee development activities to ensure a balanced team with the right set of skills

skills: Ensure all product pages are complete, accurate, up to date, and aligned with brand guidelines.
Coordinate the upload and maintenance of:
Product descriptions
Product names and claims
Product benefits and key selling points
Product images and videos
Ingredients, technical information, and specifications
Size, shade, variant, and barcode information
Usage instructions and frequently asked questions
Brand and category content
Verify that product information is consistent across all retailer platforms.
Manage new product listings, product updates, reformulations, packaging changes, discontinued products, and product replacements.
Identify and correct content errors, broken links, missing assets, duplicate listings, incorrect categorization, and outdated information.
Ensure products are properly categorized, searchable, and optimized for retailer search engines.
Work with brand and marketing teams to adapt content to each retailer’s technical and commercial requirements.
Maintain a centralized database of product assets, product information, retailer requirements, and content status.
Build and maintain an e-retail launch calendar aligned with the overall marketing and commercial calendar.
Coordinate launch timing with Brand Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and retailer contacts.
Confirm product availability, inventory readiness, product content, imagery, pricing, promotions, and campaign visibility before launch.
Ensure all launch assets are delivered to retailers on time and in the correct format.
Track the status of product listings and launch readiness by retailer.
Identify risks that could delay or weaken a launch, including stock shortages, missing content, delayed approvals, or retailer system issues.
Monitor launch performance during the first weeks and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare post-launch reviews, including availability, visibility, traffic, conversion, sales, and campaign performance.
Monitor online stock status by retailer, product, and distribution channel.
Track out-of-stock situations, low-stock risks, inactive products, and supply interruptions.
Reconcile retailer availability information with internal stock and supply planning data.
Work with Sales, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and retailer teams to resolve stock discrepancies.
Escalate recurring availability problems and identify their commercial impact.
Monitor lost sales opportunities resulting from out-of-stock situations.
Support accurate online assortment and distribution according to the agreed commercial strategy.
Ensure discontinued or unavailable products are handled correctly on retailer platforms.
Provide regular stock and availability reports to the Head of Marketing and relevant stakeholders.
Identify opportunities for homepage placements, category features, search visibility, banners, newsletters, retailer media, seasonal events, and promotional campaigns.
Negotiate with retailer contacts to obtain additional visibility and traffic-driving opportunities for the company’s brands.
Recommend suitable retailer campaigns based on brand priorities, product availability, commercial objectives, and expected return.
Coordinate the submission of campaign proposals, product selections, commercial terms, assets, and deadlines.
Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately and on time.

Position Title: E-Retail Coordinator – Distributed Brands

Department: Marketing / Commercial Operations

Reports To: Head of Marketing

Works Closely With: Director of Distributed Brands, Brand Managers, Sales and Key Account teams, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Trade Marketing, Finance, agencies, and e-retail partners.




Position Purpose

The E-Retail Coordinator is responsible for managing and developing the online presence and commercial performance of the company’s distributed brands across retailer e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and relevant digital retail channels.

The position ensures that each brand is accurately, consistently, and competitively represented online, including product content, imagery, pricing, availability, launches, promotions, and campaign execution. The role also coordinates with retail partners to improve visibility, secure promotional opportunities, monitor execution, and maximize online sales and brand performance.

This is a highly operational and results-oriented position. Success will be measured not only by the quality and accuracy of online execution, but also by the commercial performance of the brands, including online sales, conversion, visibility, stock availability, campaign results, and return on investment.




Key Responsibilities:




1. E-Retail Account and Content Management

Manage the day-to-day operational execution of the company’s brands across retailer e-commerce websites, marketplaces, and other digital retail platforms.

Responsibilities include:

Ensure all product pages are complete, accurate, up to date, and aligned with brand guidelines.
Coordinate the upload and maintenance of:
Product descriptions
Product names and claims
Product benefits and key selling points
Product images and videos
Ingredients, technical information, and specifications
Size, shade, variant, and barcode information
Usage instructions and frequently asked questions
Brand and category content
Verify that product information is consistent across all retailer platforms.
Manage new product listings, product updates, reformulations, packaging changes, discontinued products, and product replacements.
Identify and correct content errors, broken links, missing assets, duplicate listings, incorrect categorization, and outdated information.
Ensure products are properly categorized, searchable, and optimized for retailer search engines.
Work with brand and marketing teams to adapt content to each retailer’s technical and commercial requirements.
Maintain a centralized database of product assets, product information, retailer requirements, and content status.




2. New Product Launch Coordination

Coordinate the successful online launch of new products across retailer e-commerce channels.

Responsibilities include:

Build and maintain an e-retail launch calendar aligned with the overall marketing and commercial calendar.
Coordinate launch timing with Brand Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and retailer contacts.
Confirm product availability, inventory readiness, product content, imagery, pricing, promotions, and campaign visibility before launch.
Ensure all launch assets are delivered to retailers on time and in the correct format.
Track the status of product listings and launch readiness by retailer.
Identify risks that could delay or weaken a launch, including stock shortages, missing content, delayed approvals, or retailer system issues.
Monitor launch performance during the first weeks and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare post-launch reviews, including availability, visibility, traffic, conversion, sales, and campaign performance.




3. Stock and Availability Management

Support accurate and consistent product availability across e-retail platforms.

Responsibilities include:

Monitor online stock status by retailer, product, and distribution channel.
Track out-of-stock situations, low-stock risks, inactive products, and supply interruptions.
Reconcile retailer availability information with internal stock and supply planning data.
Work with Sales, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and retailer teams to resolve stock discrepancies.
Escalate recurring availability problems and identify their commercial impact.
Monitor lost sales opportunities resulting from out-of-stock situations.
Support accurate online assortment and distribution according to the agreed commercial strategy.
Ensure discontinued or unavailable products are handled correctly on retailer platforms.
Provide regular stock and availability reports to the Head of Marketing and relevant stakeholders.




4. Retailer Push, Campaign, and Promotional Negotiation

Support the negotiation and execution of retailer-led online visibility opportunities, campaigns, and promotional activities.

Responsibilities include:

Identify opportunities for homepage placements, category features, search visibility, banners, newsletters, retailer media, seasonal events, and promotional campaigns.
Negotiate with retailer contacts to obtain additional visibility and traffic-driving opportunities for the company’s brands.
Recommend suitable retailer campaigns based on brand priorities, product availability, commercial objectives, and expected return.
Coordinate the submission of campaign proposals, product selections, commercial terms, assets, and deadlines.
Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately and on time.
Verify that agreed placements, prices, promotions, banners, and product selections are correctly displayed.
Monitor campaign results and assess incremental sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, and return on investment.
Challenge underperforming activities and recommend optimization or cancellation where appropriate.
Maintain a calendar of all retailer campaigns, promotional events, investment commitments, and deliverables.
Support negotiations with facts, performance data, historical results, and category insights.




5. Online Merchandising and Brand Visibility

Improve the visibility, discoverability, and competitiveness of the brands online.

Responsibilities include:

Monitor brand positioning and product visibility across retailer websites.
Review search rankings, category placement, product recommendations, and online assortment.
Identify opportunities to improve product titles, descriptions, keywords, imagery, ratings, reviews, and content quality.
Ensure products are presented consistently with the brand strategy and visual identity.

Prioritize product content and platform corrections based on commercial impact.

description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

GTM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.
